headline_th: Water reaches your door in 40 min

actions.text_th: Move the car to the Central Ladprao car park, 1.2 km away; the road stays dry for 25 more min
Lift plugs and ground-floor things above 50 cm
Put sandbags at the door. Pick-up: Chatuchak District Office, open until midnight

sources: Reports from 11 users in the soi
